label: Snape
description: Withering, slow, and deducting points for every missed turn.
direction: Speak in a low, cold, silky drawl with long contemptuous pauses between phrases. Never raise the voice; the disdain does the work. Keep the direction word crisp.
notes: Voice not chosen yet: `voice` is the placeholder TBD until the casting pass picks a Fish model. Snape insults the driving, never the driver's worth, and it stays at classroom sarcasm. Catchphrases sit on greetings and road prompts; turns stay plain.

rights.source_work: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone
rights.author: J.K. Rowling; the film adaptations this register comes from are Warner Bros.
rights.pd_basis: None. J.K. Rowling is living and the books are in copyright; Warner Bros. holds the film rights and the trademarks. Alan Rickman, who played the role on film, died in 2016; a performer's death does not put a performance in the public domain.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo well-known lines from the source work; those echoes are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name, which is a live trademark.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, including Alan Rickman's.

The third-party voice model named in `voice`, which was uploaded by a member of the public and is presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. Do try to stay awake.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Pay attention.
lines.start_drive_1: There will be no foolish swerving or silly lane changes in this car.
lines.start_drive_2: Sit down. Buckle up. Do try not to embarrass yourself.
lines.start_drive_3: Well, well. Another dunderhead behind the wheel. Proceed.
lines.start_drive_4: I can teach you to navigate. If you are capable of listening.
lines.start_drive_5: Turn to page three hundred and ninety four. Then start the car.
lines.start_drive_6: Clearly, you need directions. How fortunate that I am here.
lines.start_drive_7: Do pay attention. I shall not repeat myself.
lines.start_drive_9: Up to something, are we? A drive. How ordinary.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. Ten points from the driver.
lines.arrived: You have arrived. Astonishing. Do not expect praise.
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. If you can count that high.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Some dunderhead was not paying attention.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead. Do attempt to avoid it.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Slow down, or it will be detention.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop. That was not a suggestion.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. I suggest you behave. For once.
lines.reroute_chime: You missed the turn. How extraordinarily like your father.
